article.title: Control del sujeto del infinitivo personal
article.part: Contraste Guatemala–Brasil y dominio avanzado C1–C2 — Contraste Guatemala–Brasil e domínio avançado C1–C2
article.chapter: Sintaxis, semántica y pragmática avanzadas — Sintaxe, semântica e pragmática avançadas

claims.summary: El infinitivo personal puede tener un sujeto explícito o recuperable cuya referencia debe coordinarse con la oración principal.
En estructuras como 'Para eles entenderem', el sujeto aparece explícitamente.
No conviene flexionar automáticamente todo infinitivo con sujeto interpretable.
En análisis avanzado, este fenómeno debe interpretarse combinando sintaxis, semántica y contexto discursivo.

links.notes: The claim is directly supported by the example 'É importante vocês chegarem cedo' where 'vocês' is the subject of 'chegarem'. The source provides a clear explanation of the concept of personal infinitive with explicit or recoverable subject.
The source provides an example 'Para eles entenderem' where the subject 'eles' is explicitly stated, supporting the claim that the subject can be explicit in such structures.
The source explicitly states that it is not advisable to automatically inflect every infinitive with interpretable subject, supporting the claim about the caution in inflection.
The source mentions that advanced analysis should combine syntax, semantics, and discourse context to interpret the phenomenon, supporting the claim about the complexity of advanced analysis.
